svg.title: Fees for taking both legs of a Kalshi and Polymarket pair
svg.desc: Both venues charge a fee for taking liquidity that is proportional to p times (1 minus p), so fees peak at 50-cent prices. With Kalshi's 0.07 rate and a Polymarket rate between 0.03 and 0.07, taking both legs costs 2.5 to 3.5 cents per 1-dollar pair at 50 cents, 3.0 cents at a 0.05 rate, and 1.75 cents when the Polymarket market is fee-free. Assumes the Polymarket leg is priced near the complement of the Kalshi leg and a Kalshi fee multiplier of 1; ignores Kalshi's rounding up to the cent per order.
